related.title: 梯度bucket：通訊重疊與尾端拖延
related.titleEn: Gradient buckets: overlap and communication tails
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：語意一致無rank遺漏，MB與GB換算正確，ring假設與實際選路分開。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Semantics/ranks agree, decimal units are correct, and modeled ring differs from observed selection.
related.difference: 從資料真正就緒時刻排程，避免把尚未產生的梯度提前通訊。
related.differenceEn: Schedule from actual readiness, never communicating gradients before production.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: ring模型T=2(p−1)α+2(p−1)D/(pB)，包含reduce-scatter與all-gather；非NCCL固定選擇保證。 以下數值均為合成教學條件，不是來源產品的規格或實測成績。 p4、D64 MB、B16 GB/s、α=10 μs，每rank同型別同count。 傳輸時間T=6×0.01+1.5×64e6/16e9×1000=6.06 ms。
單通訊引擎的bucket開始=max(就緒,前bucket完成)，整步完成取最後計算與通訊完成最大值。 以下數值均為合成教學條件，不是來源產品的規格或實測成績。 三bucket就緒2、5、8 ms，每個通訊2 ms，計算於8 ms結束。 通訊區間[2,4]、[5,7]、[8,10]，整步10 ms，尾端2 ms。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Ring model T=2(p−1)α+2(p−1)D/(pB), covering reduce-scatter/all-gather; NCCL need not always choose ring. All numbers below are synthetic teaching conditions, not specifications or measured results of the cited product. p4, D64 decimal MB, B16 GB/s,α10 μs, and identical count/type per rank. T=6×0.01+1.5×64e6/16e9×1000=6.06 ms.

On one communication engine, start=max(readiness, previous finish); step completion is the last compute/communication finish. All numbers below are synthetic teaching conditions, not specifications or measured results of the cited product. Three buckets ready at 2, 5, 8 ms, each taking2 ms communication; compute ends at 8 ms. Communication intervals[2, 4],[5, 7],[8, 10] give10 ms completion and 2 ms tail.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: 推測式解碼：接受率與驗證回合
related.titleEn: Speculative decoding: acceptance and verification rounds
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：語意一致無rank遺漏，MB與GB換算正確，ring假設與實際選路分開。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Semantics/ranks agree, decimal units are correct, and modeled ring differs from observed selection.
related.difference: 區分提出token、接受token與最終輸出，計入草稿成本及正確拒絕修正。
related.differenceEn: Distinguish proposed, accepted and emitted tokens, including draft cost and rejection correction.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: ring模型T=2(p−1)α+2(p−1)D/(pB)，包含reduce-scatter與all-gather；非NCCL固定選擇保證。 以下數值均為合成教學條件，不是來源產品的規格或實測成績。 p4、D64 MB、B16 GB/s、α=10 μs，每rank同型別同count。 傳輸時間T=6×0.01+1.5×64e6/16e9×1000=6.06 ms。
常數獨立接受率α、γ個草稿及一個額外輸出時，每回合理想期望Σ(k=0..γ)α^k；只是簡化模型。 以下數值均為合成教學條件，不是來源產品的規格或實測成績。 γ3、α0.8，先不計草稿與驗證時間差；分布保持另需正確演算法。 期望=1+0.8+0.64+0.512=2.952 token/回合。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Ring model T=2(p−1)α+2(p−1)D/(pB), covering reduce-scatter/all-gather; NCCL need not always choose ring. All numbers below are synthetic teaching conditions, not specifications or measured results of the cited product. p4, D64 decimal MB, B16 GB/s,α10 μs, and identical count/type per rank. T=6×0.01+1.5×64e6/16e9×1000=6.06 ms.

With independent constant acceptanceα,γ drafts and one extra output, ideal expected output isΣα^k for k0..γ. All numbers below are synthetic teaching conditions, not specifications or measured results of the cited product. γ3,α0.8, initially excluding draft/verification timing; distribution preservation requires the correct algorithm. Expected output=2.952 tokens/round.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
